text:
alyssa: FYI we're planning to enable aurora-8b-quant-v3 in the catalog during the 23:30-01:30 UTC change window tonight. Need quick alignment on rollout cadence, regional warmup, and an explicit emergency rollback ladder.

release-bot: scheduled by @alyssa for 3533337000. Canary flow: 4% for 12m -> 20% for 25m -> full. Auto-rollback triggers: error_rate > 1.6% OR p95 increase > 30% over baseline.

ben: propose the following fallback and rollback ladder to avoid surprise model oscillation:
```yaml
catalog_fallbacks:
  - aurora-8b-quant-v3
  - aurora-8b-quant-v2
  - aurora-8b
rollback_ladder:
  - immediate_drain_to: aurora-8b-quant-v2
  - staged_revert_to: aurora-8b (if persistent within 60m)
pin_lock_minutes: 120
fallback_debounce_minutes: 10
regional_warmup: na_then_eu_manual
```
That gives us a fast immediate drain path and a staged revert if things don't recover.

marc: +1. Request eu_priming be manual. EU hosts had higher cache churn last week. Also add host_mem_threshold: 70% to trigger an immediate rollback.

ops-bot: noted. Adding mem_threshold=70% to automated monitor. If crossed, ops-bot will surface an urgent drain alert to #eng-oncall.

sre-oncall: Oncall will watch the first canary tranche. We'll confirm go/no-go for EU priming after NA 20-minute canary. If we see evictions or >3 OOM events, we call for immediate drain.

alyssa: good. Also want a short release-note blurb calling out staged warmup and the 2h pin window so customers understand why we might revert quickly.

ben: config snippet for release-bot (paste into release config):
```json
{"model":"aurora-8b-quant-v3","canary_pct":4,"canary_minutes":12,"ramp_pct":20,"pin_lock_minutes":120,"fallback_debounce_minutes":10,"eu_priming":"manual","mem_threshold_percent":70}
```

marc: i'll wire up telemetry: token-level latency, fallback_rate, mem_pressure, and canary_error_rate. ETA 30m.

alyssa: final checklist: (1) release-bot schedule set, (2) eu priming = manual after NA canary, (3) fallback_ladder + rollback_ladder in config, (4) pin_lock = 120m, (5) dashboards + alerts ready. Object?

release-bot: preflight checks completed. All canary machines report healthy. Deploy will start at scheduled epoch unless aborted.

ben: no objections. I'll be watching the rollback ladder and will execute immediate_drain_to if any threshold crosses.

alyssa: thanks team. kicking off at 3533337000. Ping this thread for any rollback or abort requests. :rocket:
